scripts.dev: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run dev --workspace @brass-ledger/server
scripts.start: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run start --workspace @brass-ledger/server
scripts.start:dist: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run start:dist --workspace @brass-ledger/server
scripts.dev:split: npm run dev --workspace @brass-ledger/server & npm run dev --workspace @brass-ledger/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:release
scripts.lint:content: npm run lint:content --workspace @brass-ledger/content && npm run test:doctrine-reachability --workspace @brass-ledger/sim
